'''Scraaz''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who betrayed the [[Exchange]]<ref name="Dead" /> criminal syndicate<ref name="Exchange Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Exchange}}</ref> roughly a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] prior to<ref name="Dead" /> [[3643 BBY]]. By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Dead and Gone" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> he had become tired of being on the run and wished to hire someone to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into official records to list him as [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="Dead" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around the year 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to assist Scraaz. The companion sliced into official [[Memory bank/Legends|databanks]] to plant falsified records that detailed Scraaz suddenly dying and [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forged]] electronic documents to give the Rodian a new identity.<ref name="Dead" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Scraaz was mentioned in the Crew Skill Mission "Dead and Gone" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Dead" />
